# COMMON WEATHER

## Identity
- Series: COMMON WEATHER
- Label phrase: Ride out. Walk on.
- CW01 and CW02 label location: inside back neck
- CW03 label location: inside back waistband
- Hardware engraving: R1
- Main color: Moss #465B57
- Panel and trim color: Clay #B86E50
- Hardware finish: matte charcoal
- Development size: M
- Extended size range: S, M, L

## Garment records
| Code | Name | Fabric | Construction features |
|---|---|---|---|
| CW01 | Hooded Shell | F01 | Fixed hood; center-front zipper; one chest pocket; two hand pockets; three reflective pieces |
| CW02 | Layering Vest | F02 | Sleeveless; center-front zipper; position beneath CW01 |
| CW03 | Overtrousers | F01 | Articulated knees; elastic waistband; one webbing buckle adjustment at each ankle |

## Fabric records
| Code | Composition | Weight | Usable width | Construction | Surface finish | Seam construction |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| F01 | Face: 100% nylon; membrane: polyurethane | 125 g/m² total | 1450 mm | 2.5-layer laminate; 40-denier plain-weave face; printed inner protective layer | Matte face; water-repellent finish | Lockstitch; 10 mm seam allowance; 20 mm internal seam tape |
| F02 | 100% polyester | 180 g/m² | 1500 mm | Warp-knitted tricot | Brushed inner face; smooth outer face | Overlock; 6 mm seam allowance |

## Size M movement and storage
- CW01 front body length: 720 mm from high shoulder point to front hem
- CW01 back body length: 800 mm from high shoulder point to back hem
- Back drop: 80 mm
- Reference sleeve: 660 mm from shoulder point to cuff
- CW01 sleeve: 690 mm from shoulder point to cuff
- Sleeve extension: 30 mm
- Collar height: 80 mm from neckline seam to upper edge at center front
- Riding torso angle: 35 degrees forward from vertical
- Reference body chest circumference: 1000 mm
- CW01 finished chest circumference: 1180 mm
- CW01 chest ease: 180 mm

| Item | Storage location | Packed envelope |
|---|---|---|
| Phone | CW01 chest pocket | 170 × 85 × 12 mm |
| Gloves together | CW01 right-hand pocket | 220 × 110 × 40 mm |
| Cap | CW01 left-hand pocket | 180 × 100 × 30 mm |

## Reflective components
| Location | Count | Dimensions | Position |
|---|---|---|---|
| Outer cuffs | 2 | 60 × 10 mm each | One on each outer cuff |
| Center back | 1 | 120 × 10 mm | Horizontal; lower edge 100 mm above back hem |

## Shared hardware
- R1 pull: flat rounded rectangle, 24 × 8 mm, corner radius 2 mm
- Pull attachment slot: 12 × 3 mm, centered across the width in the upper portion
- Pull engraving: R1, centered below the slot
- Buckle: rectangular three-bar ladder lock, 35 × 30 mm outer envelope
- Buckle webbing: 25 mm wide
- CW01 hardware locations: center-front zipper and three pocket zippers
- CW02 hardware location: center-front zipper
- CW03 hardware locations: left and right ankle adjustment straps

## Finished garment measurements
All measurements in mm. Circumferences are full garment circumferences. Body lengths run from high shoulder point to hem. Pocket drop runs vertically from high shoulder point to the top of the chest-pocket opening. Pocket offset runs horizontally from center front to the nearest edge of that opening. Knee position runs down the side seam from the top of the waistband to the center of knee articulation.

- CW01 back drop: 80 mm in S, M and L

## Outfit records
| Setting | Size | Garments | Wearing state |

| Weekday cycling | M | CW01 + CW02 + CW03 | Shell closed over vest; forward reach to handlebars |
| Weekend trail | M | CW01 + CW02 + CW03 | Shell open over vest; walking with a small daypack |
| Café arrival | M | CW01 + CW02 + CW03 | Shell carried over one arm; vest and overtrousers worn |
| Weekday cycling | S | CW01 + CW02 + CW03 | Shell closed over vest; forward reach to handlebars |
| Weekend trail | L | CW01 + CW02 + CW03 | Shell open over vest; walking with a small daypack |

steps.userMessage:
COMMON WEATHER | A rain wardrobe for the ride and the walk

We are building a three-piece wardrobe for adults who cycle to work and spend weekends on local trails. The same clothes need to work on the bike, at a café table and on foot with a small daypack. The range comprises CW01 Hooded Shell, CW02 Layering Vest and CW03 Overtrousers. Overall silhouette and panel design are open. Our existing R1 zipper pull and webbing buckle are the shared hardware identity. Print "COMMON WEATHER" and "Ride out. Walk on." on the inside neck labels of CW01 and CW02 and the inside waistband label of CW03.

Develop the main garments in size M. CW01 has a fixed hood, a 720 mm front body length, an 800 mm back body length, an 80 mm collar and a 690 mm sleeve measured from shoulder point to cuff, including a 30 mm extension over our 660 mm reference sleeve. It has three zipped pockets: chest storage for a phone measuring 170 × 85 × 12 mm, right-hand storage for gloves packed to 220 × 110 × 40 mm and left-hand storage for a cap packed to 180 × 100 × 30 mm. Place one 60 × 10 mm reflective tab on each outer cuff and one 120 × 10 mm strip across the center back, 100 mm above the back hem. CW02 sits beneath CW01; CW03 has articulated knees and a buckle adjustment at each ankle. Use F01 for the shell and overtrousers: a 125 g/m², 1450 mm-wide, 2.5-layer laminate with a 100% nylon 40-denier plain-weave face and polyurethane membrane. F02 for the vest is a 180 g/m², 1500 mm-wide, 100% polyester brushed tricot. The main color is Moss #465B57, with Clay #B86E50 available for panels and trims.

Audience: our product lead, pattern cutter and sample room will use the work to choose the range and prepare its first samples for adults seeking one wardrobe for commuting and light outdoor use.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the garment records, fabric specifications, size measurements and hardware dimensions. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists every deliverable's proportion, format and stage. riding-envelope.png supplies the cycling posture, length increments and carried-item envelopes. shared-hardware.png records the existing R1 pull and ankle buckle whose forms carry through the range. wet-crossing.png supplies the weekday street atmosphere. weekend-trail.png supplies the walking environment and weekend light.

Deliverables:
1. Three distinct wardrobe direction boards, one each for directions A, B and C, each showing all three styles and a proposed silhouette, panel arrangement and color placement
2. One selection note naming A, B or C and explaining the choice for handlebar reach, pocket access and walking use
3. One materials and craft sheet for the selected direction, recording both fabrics' composition, weight, width, construction and finish, seam methods, hardware dimensions, style-to-fabric assignments, colors and CW01's length measurements
4. One front flat-lay lineup and one back flat-lay lineup of CW01, CW02 and CW03, with enlarged inside-label views on the front lineup and shell measurements on the back lineup
5. Three worn images: forward-leaning cycling with all three garments, trail walking with the shell open over the vest, and a café arrival with the shell carried over one arm and the vest worn
6. One construction-detail plate covering the three loaded shell pockets, three reflective pieces, R1 zipper pull, ankle buckles and articulated knees
7. One material close-up plate containing a finished fabric-and-color crop from each garment, labeled with its style code, fabric code and color code
8. One 12-second video showing the same wearer layering CW01 over CW02, reaching forward to handlebars and walking in CW03
9. One range presentation of at least 8 pages, reusing the direction boards, selection, materials and craft sheet, garment lineups, details and worn images

Acceptance:
- The three direction boards precede the selection note; the note names A, B or C, and the materials and craft sheet, garment images, video and presentation develop that selection. The presentation's first page repeats its letter.
- The materials and craft sheet assigns F01 to CW01 and CW03, F02 to CW02 and Moss #465B57 as the main color; the material close-up plate and presentation repeat those codes and assignments. The sheet records 10 mm seam allowances and 20 mm seam tape for F01, 6 mm overlocked allowances for F02, the 24 × 8 mm R1 pull and the 35 × 30 mm buckle for 25 mm webbing.
- The materials and craft sheet, back lineup, construction-detail plate and presentation repeat CW01's 720 mm front length, 800 mm back length, 80 mm collar and 690 mm sleeve, including the 80 mm back drop and 30 mm sleeve extension.
- The construction-detail plate dimensions all three carried-item envelopes and the three reflective pieces specified in the brief; the front and back lineups, worn images and video retain the selected garments' corresponding pockets, seams and closures.
- The front lineup's enlarged labels print COMMON WEATHER and Ride out. Walk on. for CW01, CW02 and CW03; the detail plate shows the R1 engraving and two ankle buckles. The material close-up plate and presentation identify all three style codes and COMMON WEATHER.
- The three worn images cover cycling, trail walking and café arrival; the 12-second video contains layering, handlebar reach and walking, and the presentation contains at least 8 pages reusing all three worn images.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
